mintAuthority.summary: USAT's verified HadronToken source exposes owner-only mint and redeem functions. The token and its transparent ProxyAdmin are both controlled immediately by the same legacy 3/5 multisig contract.

controls.label: USAT owner-only minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526649, the USAT proxy owner() and ProxyAdmin owner() both returned this address. required() returned 3 and getOwners() returned five current legacy multisig owner slots: 0x6744A526..., 0x106743fD..., 0xD3Fc71bD..., 0x68298631..., and 0x1e1Ed372.... Verified HadronToken source exposes mint(address,uint256), redeem(uint256), and destroyBlockedFunds as owner-only functions.

sources.label: OCC active regional and midsize institutions

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526649, the EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots resolved to implementation 0x8b98bcd9b1f8ae112fb2b58b45c3bc9a75cc4d0e and ProxyAdmin 0x3e4c6460aa00c11c81e3c5b95b15d612f5f2d9c7. ProxyAdmin.owner() and token owner() both returned the same reviewed legacy multisig, whose current required() value is 3 and getOwners() returned five signers. The verified HadronToken source confirms owner-only mint and redeem authority; ProxyAdmin source exposes immediate owner-only upgrades with no timelock. On 2026-07-15, Anchorage's primary transparency page listed monthly Big Four AICPA attestations for January through May 2026 and identified Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as issuer; the OCC's current institution list independently confirmed the active national bank. USAT is therefore periodically reconciled and prudentially supervised, while its no-delay issuer-controlled mint is economically unbounded.
